data.long_meaning: The name Parkesh is derived from the Sanskrit language and is a compound word consisting of 'Para' meaning supreme and 'Kshetra' meaning place or abode. The name is a reverence to Lord Vishnu, the preserver of the universe. In Hindu mythology, Vishnu is believed to have created and protected the universe. Parkesh, as a name, is believed to bring blessings of peace, prosperity, and protection.
